description: SCV hooks. Two kinds, and the distinction is the contract: the journal capture on UserPromptSubmit/Stop is non-blocking by design (the Core templates exit 0 on every failure and write nothing outside scv/journal/, with redaction running before anything hits disk; on UserPromptSubmit the template also prints the plain-language answer-shape reminder to stdout, which Codex adds to the model context — Core 0.31.0+), while the PreToolUse guard is deliberately blocking — it denies writes that no SCV action accounts for. The plugin directory comes from PLUGIN_ROOT (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT is the alias this host also sets); there is no CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT, and naming it left the path empty, the script missing, and the guard silently inert. Both guard entries carry the SAME environment on purpose: SCV_GUARD_SCRIPTS lists the vendored Core scripts AND adapter/scripts (colon-separated, Core 0.28.0+) so the adapter-routed actions mint, and SCV_GUARD_EXEMPT rides on gate-bash too, so a config.toml patch is allowed through the shell path exactly as through the editor path — they diverged once and the same edit was allowed one way and denied the other. The guard fails open only on an empty payload or a missing JSON reader, and is inert in projects that have not adopted SCV. See plugins/scv/vendor/scv-core/core/contracts/guard.md.
